one_liner: Nifty 50 gains 0.25% amid IT sector strength and positive institutional flows.

drivers.title: IT Sector Surge
drivers.detail: HCLTECH, TCS, and INFY led the gains.

drivers.title: Institutional Buying
drivers.detail: FIIs and DIIs were net buyers.

flows_line: FIIs and DIIs were net buyers in the cash market, with inflows of Rs 5,843.33 Cr and Rs 5,630.72 Cr respectively.
watch_next: Tomorrow, watch for corporate actions including a face value split for VGL and a dividend for FUSIONCX.
lesson_seeds: IT sector gains can drive broader index performance.
Institutional flows can influence market direction.
Global cues impact local market sentiment.
